shortDescription: The Shangai Composite Index fell 4 points or 0.10 percent on Friday to close at 3953 points.Leading the losses are Industrial Bank (-3.05%), Sdic Power (-1.94%) and Datang Intl (-1.18%).Top gainers were Hengli Petrochemical (3.92%), Guangzhou Automobile (3.87%) and Sinopec (3.59%).
